brief: An open source MCP server that lets AI agents (Claude, Cursor, Codex) operate a CapRover server. It starts read-only and asks before it deletes: trustworthy, precise and developer-friendly.
criteria: Recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour, and distinct from the CapRover mark and from the Docker and Kubernetes marks.

concepts.name: Sealed container
concepts.idea: A container cube with one sealed face: it operates apps and starts protected.
rationale: The solid face is the read-only default made visible
A cube is the native shape of a PaaS and of containers
Reads at 16 px and in one colour
